$comment: A registered AI agent and its accountable owner, as a gateway's agent registry returns it (synoi-gateway GET /v1/account/agents). The owner is a person, named by an operator OID enrolled for the same tenant ('oid-' + sha256 of the operator's Ed25519 public key); it is not a role. Every owner event (owner_assigned, owner_changed, retired) is written as a signed hosted-v1.2 Decision Receipt whose signed agent_id and owner_oid name the agent and its owner, whose target_class is 'agent', and whose signed state_sha256 is sha256 of the event's state_json (so the previous owner and who made the change are covered by the signature). Receipts produced while an agent's bound credential is in use sign the same agent_id and owner_oid; see receipt-versions.json hosted-v1.2, where both stay OPTIONAL. The credential binding itself (a SHA-256 of the Bearer key) is never part of this shape. Vendored by synoi-gateway src/agents/registry.ts with a drift test (test/agent-owner-registry.test.ts). Read at TEST time only.
title: Agent

owner_oid.description: The accountable person. null = no owner yet (an ownerless-agent finding).

updated_at.description: Unix ms of the last change.

credential_bound.description: True when a gateway credential is bound to this agent, so its receipts carry agent_id / owner_oid.

receipt_id.description: The signed receipt for this event; null only if signing failed (the receipt is dead-lettered).

state_json.description: Sorted-key compact JSON of {agent_id, at, changed_by, changed_by_agent_id, event, owner_oid, previous_owner_oid, status, tenant_id}. The receipt's signed state_sha256 is sha256(state_json).

owner_oid.description: The recorded owner, if any (set when reason is owner_not_enrolled).
